WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT sc.observstation,
       sc.telescope_count,
       CAST(sc.telescope_count AS REAL) / total.total_count AS share
FROM station_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only stations with at least one telescope are included, since the station list is derived from telescopes.
